headline: Last session: Sensex plunged 1,484 points amid market crash; markets closed today for Guru Nanak Jayanti

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: Dalal Street witnessed a broad-based sell-off in the last session, dragging the Sensex down by 1,484 points.
Metal and banking sectors suffered severe losses, leading the market downturn.
Investors lost over ₹6 lakh crore in market wealth during the previous trading session's sharp decline.
Markets are closed today, November 24, on account of the Guru Nanak Jayanti holiday.
whatHappening: Tata Motors PV announced price hikes across its cars and SUVs effective from December 1.
Vehicle scrapping rules were eased, saving Indian automakers an estimated ₹25,000 crore burden.
MeitY revised local content rules for government purchases of laptops, PCs, and servers, requiring motherboard assembly in India.
India and China are projected to record peak Russian oil imports in 2026 amidst the ongoing Iran war.
summary: In the last trading session, Indian benchmark indices crashed sharply with the Sensex plunging 1,484 points, wiping out over ₹6 lakh crore in investor wealth. Equity markets are closed today, November 24, for Guru Nanak Jayanti. Trading activity will resume on Wednesday, November 25.
